description_en: Synchronizes Elastic Compute Service (ECS), Classic Load Balancer (CLB), and Network Load Balancer (NLB) instances to Web Application Firewall (WAF)
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi sync-product-instance --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-zsk0000fb09 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm4co0000f5qa --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SyncProductInstance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: regions outside the Chinese mainland
